title: Viasat Wins First Task Order Award as part of $307 Million Ceiling U.S. Marine Corps Enterprise Services Contract for Multi-Orbit Connectivity
author: Na
description: Viasat Inc. has been awarded an initial $42 million task order under a seven-year, up to $307 million IDIQ contract to provide fully managed, end-to-end global satellite services for the United States Marine Corps. The contract covers multi-orbit connectivity across L-, Ku, and Ka-bands, including access to Viasat's next-generation ViaSat-3 satellites, with 24x7x365 network and security operations support.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Viasat secured a significant $307 million ceiling contract with the U.S. Marine Corps, demonstrating strong government sector demand, contract expansion opportunities, and validation of its multi-orbit satellite capabilities. The initial $42 million task order and seven-year duration indicate substantial revenue potential and long-term business stability.

title: Space42 与 Viasat 签署约束性协议，共同创立 Equatys，打造全球首个面向直连设备与先进 MSS 连接的共享太空及地面基础设施平台
author: Na
description: Space42 and Viasat have signed a binding agreement to establish Equatys, a shared satellite and ground infrastructure platform for direct-to-device (D2D) and advanced mobile satellite services. The two companies will commit up to $1 billion in combined equity, with each contributing $400 million initially and Space42 adding $200 million in a future third-party funding round. The platform will operate on a 'tower company' model, allowing multiple operators to share standardized infrastructure while maintaining independent customer relationships. Viasat will serve as the chief technology contractor.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Viasat secures a strategic role as chief technology contractor with $400 million equity commitment and access to a massive addressable market (projected $300-700 billion by 2040). The partnership leverages its MSS spectrum assets and technical expertise while reducing individual capital burden through shared infrastructure model.

author: Na
description: Space42 and Viasat have signed a binding agreement to establish Equatys, a neutral shared space and ground infrastructure platform for Direct-to-Device (D2D) and advanced Mobile Satellite Service (MSS) connectivity. The companies commit up to $1 billion in combined equity investments, with Space42 and Viasat each investing $400 million initially, and Space42 committing an additional $200 million in future funding rounds. Equatys will operate on a tower company model, enabling multiple satellite operators to share infrastructure while maintaining independent frequency rights and customer relationships. The platform is designed to scale to 2,800 satellites across 60 orbital planes and 3 altitude layers.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Viasat is a co-founder with $400 million initial equity commitment and designated as the prime technology contractor for Equatys. The company brings internationally coordinated L-band MSS frequency rights globally and S-band MSS rights in Europe, plus relationships with 400+ mobile operators. This positions Viasat to benefit from infrastructure-level returns and long-term growth in the emerging D2D NTN market.

author: Na

The two companies commit up to $1 billion in combined equity funding. The initial constellation is designed to expand to 2,800 satellites across 60 orbital planes and three altitude layers.
